name: luvify
description: Luvify - AI-powered website building platform (React + TypeScript + Express + Prisma)

scripts.typecheck: npm --workspace @luvify/shared run typecheck && npm --workspace @luvify/site-renderer run typecheck && npm --workspace @luvify/server run typecheck && npm --workspace @luvify/web run typecheck
scripts.test: npm --workspace @luvify/shared run test && npm --workspace @luvify/site-renderer run test && npm --workspace @luvify/server run test
scripts.db:sqlite: node scripts/sync-sqlite-schema.mjs && prisma db push --schema prisma/sqlite/schema.prisma --skip-generate && prisma generate --schema prisma/sqlite/schema.prisma
scripts.setup: npm run db:sqlite && npm run db:seed
